text_en: Soon afterwards he went on through cities and villages, proclaiming and bringing the good news of the kingdom of God. The twelve were with him,
text_cn: 以后，耶稣走遍各城各村讲道，宣传天主国的喜讯，同他在一起的有那十二门徒，

text_en: as well as some women who had been cured of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary, called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
text_cn: 还有几个曾附过恶魔或患病而得治好的妇女，有号称玛达肋纳的玛利亚，从她身上赶出了七个魔鬼；

text_en: and Joanna, the wife of Herod’s steward Chuza, and Susanna, and many others, who provided for them out of their resources.
text_cn: 还有约安纳，即黑落德的家宰雇撒的妻子，又有苏撒纳；还有别的许多妇女，她们都用自己的财产资助他们。

text_en: When a great crowd gathered and people from town after town came to him, he said in a parable:
text_cn: 那时，有大伙群众聚集了来，并有从各城来到耶稣跟前的，他就用比喻说：

text_en: “A sower went out to sow his seed; and as he sowed, some fell on the path and was trampled on, and the birds of the air ate it up.
text_cn: “有一个撒种子的，出去撒种子；他撒的时候；有的落在路旁，就被践踏了，并有天上的飞鸟把它吃了。

text_en: Some fell on the rock; and as it grew up, it withered for lack of moisture.
text_cn: 有的落在石头上，一长起来，就干枯了，因为没有湿气。

text_en: Some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.
text_cn: 有的落在荆棘中，荆棘同它一起长起来，把它窒息了。

text_en: Some fell into good soil, and when it grew, it produced a hundredfold. ” As he said this, he called out, “Let anyone with ears to hear listen! ”
text_cn: 又有的落在好地里，长起来，结了百倍的果实。”他说完这些话，就高呼说：“有耳听的，就听罢！”

text_en: Then his disciples asked him what this parable meant.
text_cn: 他的门徒问他这比喻有什么意思。

text_en: He said, “To you it has been given to know the secrets of the kingdom of God; but to others I speak in parables, so that ‘looking they may not perceive, and listening they may not understand. ’
text_cn: 他说：“天主国的奥秘，是给你们知道的；对其余的人，就用比喻，使那看的，却看不见；听的，却听不懂。

text_en: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
text_cn: 这比喻的意思是：种子是天主的话。

text_en: The ones on the path are those who have heard; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
text_cn: 那些在路旁的，是指那些人听了，随后就有魔鬼来到，从他们心中把那话夺去，使他们不至信从而得救。

text_en: The ones on the rock are those who, when they hear the word, receive it with joy. But these have no root; they believe only for a while and in a time of testing fall away.
text_cn: 那些在石头上的，是指那些人，他们听的时候，高兴地接受那话，但这些人没有根，暂时相信，一到试探的时候，就退避了。

text_en: As for what fell among the thorns, these are the ones who hear; but as they go on their way, they are choked by the cares and riches and pleasures of life, and their fruit does not mature.
text_cn: 那落在荆棘中的，是指那些听了的人，还在中途就被挂虑、钱财及生活的逸乐所蒙蔽，没有结出成熟的果实。

text_en: But as for that in the good soil, these are the ones who, when they hear the word, hold it fast in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patient endurance.
text_cn: 那在好地里的，是指那些以善良和诚实的心倾听的人，他们把这话保存起来，以坚忍结出果实。

text_en: “No one after lighting a lamp hides it under a jar, or puts it under a bed, but puts it on a lampstand, so that those who enter may see the light.
text_cn: 没有人点上灯，用器皿遮盖住，或放在床底下的，而是放在灯台上，为叫进来的人看见光明。

text_en: For nothing is hidden that will not be disclosed, nor is anything secret that will not become known and come to light.
text_cn: 因为没有隐藏的事，不成为显露的；没有秘密的事，不被知道而公开出来的。

text_en: Then pay attention to how you listen; for to those who have, more will be given; and from those who do not have, even what they seem to have will be taken away. ”
text_cn: 所以，你们应当留心要怎样听；因为凡有的，还要给他；凡没有的，连他自以为有的，也要从他夺去。”

text_en: Then his mother and his brothers came to him, but they could not reach him because of the crowd.
text_cn: 耶稣的母亲和兄弟到他这里来了，因为人多，不能与他相会。

text_en: And he was told, “Your mother and your brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you. ”
text_cn: 有人告诉他说：“你的母亲和你的兄弟站在外边，愿意见你。”

text_en: But he said to them, “My mother and my brothers are those who hear the word of God and do it. ”
text_cn: 他却回答他们说：“听了天主的话而实行的，才是我的母亲和我的兄弟。”

text_en: One day he got into a boat with his disciples, and he said to them, “Let us go across to the other side of the lake. ” So they put out,
text_cn: 有一天，耶稣和门徒上了船，对他们说：“我们渡到湖那边去。”他们便开了船。

text_en: and while they were sailing he fell asleep. A windstorm swept down on the lake, and the boat was filling with water, and they were in danger.
text_cn: 正在航行时，他睡着了。忽然有狂风降到湖上，进入船中的水，使他们处于危险中。

text_en: They went to him and woke him up, shouting, “Master, Master, we are perishing! ” And he woke up and rebuked the wind and the raging waves; they ceased, and there was a calm.
text_cn: 门徒们前来叫醒耶稣说：“老师！老师！我们要丧亡了！”他醒起来，叱责了狂风和波浪，风浪就止息平静了。

text_en: He said to them, “Where is your faith? ” They were afraid and amazed, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him? ”
text_cn: 遂对他们说：“你们的信德在哪里？”他们又害怕又惊奇，彼此说：“这人到底是谁，因为他一出命，风和水也都服从他。”

text_en: Then they arrived at the country of the Gerasenes, which is opposite Galilee.
text_cn: 他们航行到革辣撒人的地方，就是加里肋亚的对面。

text_en: As he stepped out on land, a man of the city who had demons met him. For a long time he had worn no clothes, and he did not live in a house but in the tombs.
text_cn: 耶稣一上了岸，迎面来了一个那城中附魔的人，他很久不穿衣服，也不住在家里，而住在坟墓中。

text_en: When he saw Jesus, he fell down before him and shouted at the top of his voice, “What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, do not torment me”—
text_cn: 他一看见耶稣，就喊叫起来，跪伏在他前大声说：“至高天主之子耶稣，我与你有什么相干？我求你不要磨难我！”

text_en: for Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. (For many times it had seized him; he was kept under guard and bound with chains and shackles, but he would break the bonds and be driven by the demon into the wilds. )
text_cn: 因为他曾命令邪魔从那人身上出去，原来邪魔已多次抓住他，他曾被铁链和脚镣捆缚起来，被看管着；他却挣断锁链，被魔鬼赶到荒野中。

text_en: Jesus then asked him, “What is your name? ” He said, “Legion”; for many demons had entered him.
text_cn: 耶稣问他说：“你叫什么名字？”他说：“军旅。”因为有许多魔鬼进入了他身内。

text_en: They begged him not to order them to go back into the abyss.
text_cn: 魔鬼求耶稣，不要命令他们到深渊中去。

text_en: Now there on the hillside a large herd of swine was feeding; and the demons begged Jesus to let them enter these. So he gave them permission.
text_cn: 在那里有一大群猪在山上牧放着，魔鬼就恳求耶稣许他们进入那些猪内；耶稣准许了他们。

text_en: Then the demons came out of the man and entered the swine, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
text_cn: 于是，魔鬼从那人身上出去，进入猪内。那群猪就从山崖上直冲到湖里淹死了。

text_en: When the swineherds saw what had happened, they ran off and told it in the city and in the country.
text_cn: 放猪的看见发生的事，就逃去，到城里和乡间传报开了。

text_en: Then people came out to see what had happened, and when they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind. And they were afraid.
text_cn: 人就出来看那发生的事，来到耶稣前，发现脱离魔鬼的那人，穿着衣服，神智清醒，坐在耶稣跟前；他们就害怕起来。

text_en: Those who had seen it told them how the one who had been possessed by demons had been healed.
text_cn: 那些见过这事的人就对他们述说：那附魔的人怎样被治好了。

text_en: Then all the people of the surrounding country of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them; for they were seized with great fear. So he got into the boat and returned.
text_cn: 革辣撒四周所有的人民要求耶稣离开他们因为他们十分恐惧。他便上船回去。

text_en: The man from whom the demons had gone begged that he might be with him; but Jesus sent him away, saying,
text_cn: 脱离魔鬼的那人祈求耶稣，要同耶稣在一起；但耶稣打发他回去，说：

text_en: “Return to your home, and declare how much God has done for you. ” So he went away, proclaiming throughout the city how much Jesus had done for him.
text_cn: “你回家去罢，传述天主为你作了何等大事！”他就去了，满城传扬耶稣为他作了何等大事。

text_en: Now when Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.
text_cn: 耶稣回来时，群众就迎接他，因为众人都在等候他。

text_en: Just then there came a man named Jairus, a leader of the synagogue. He fell at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come to his house,
text_cn: 看，来了一个人，名叫雅依洛，这人是一个会堂长，他跪伏在耶稣脚前，求他到自己家中去，

text_en: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years old, who was dying. As he went, the crowds pressed in on him.
text_cn: 因为他有一个独生女，约十二岁，快要死了。当耶稣去的时候，群众都拥挤他。

text_en: Now there was a woman who had been suffering from hemorrhages for twelve years; and though she had spent all she had on physicians, no one could cure her.
text_cn: 有一个妇人，十二年来患血漏病，把全部家产都花在医生身上，却没有一个能治好她。

text_en: She came up behind him and touched the fringe of his clothes, and immediately her hemorrhage stopped.
text_cn: 她来到耶稣后边，摸了摸他的衣服穗头，她的血漏立刻就止住了。

text_en: Then Jesus asked, “Who touched me? ” When all denied it, Peter said, “Master, the crowds surround you and press in on you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“谁摸了我？”众人都否认；伯多禄说：“老师，群众都在拥挤着你！”

text_en: But Jesus said, “Someone touched me; for I noticed that power had gone out from me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣却说：“有人摸了我，因为我觉得有能力从我身上出去了。”

text_en: When the woman saw that she could not remain hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him, she declared in the presence of all the people why she had touched him, and how she had been immediately healed.
text_cn: 那妇人看不能隐瞒，就战战兢兢地来跪伏在耶稣跟前，把自己摸他的原故和如何立刻病好的事，在众百姓面前都说了出来。

text_en: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace. ”
text_cn: 耶稣遂对他说：“女儿，你的信德救了你，平安去罢！”

text_en: While he was still speaking, someone came from the leader’s house to say, “Your daughter is dead; do not trouble the teacher any longer. ”
text_cn: 他还在说话时，有人从会堂长家里来说：“你的女儿死了，不必烦劳师傅了。”

text_en: When Jesus heard this, he replied, “Do not fear. Only believe, and she will be saved. ”
text_cn: 耶稣听了，就对他说：“不要害怕，只管信，她必得救。”

text_en: When he came to the house, he did not allow anyone to enter with him, except Peter, John, and James, and the child’s father and mother.
text_cn: 耶稣到了那家里，除伯多禄、若望、雅各伯和女孩子的父母外，不让任何人同他进去。

text_en: They were all weeping and wailing for her; but he said, “Do not weep; for she is not dead but sleeping. ”
text_cn: 众人都在痛哭哀吊女孩子。他却说：“不要哭泣！她并没有死，只是睡着了。”

text_en: And they laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.
text_cn: 那些明知她已死的人，就讥笑他。

text_en: But he took her by the hand and called out, “Child, get up! ”
text_cn: 耶稣拿起她的手来，喊说：“女孩，起来！”

text_en: Her spirit returned, and she got up at once. Then he directed them to give her something to eat.
text_cn: 她的灵魂回来了，她就立刻起来了。耶稣吩咐给她吃的。

text_en: Her parents were astounded; but he ordered them to tell no one what had happened.
text_cn: 她的父母惊讶的出神。耶稣却警告他们不要传扬这事。
